stem:
Arhaan watches a pigeon fly using its wings, a rabbit hop using its hind legs, and a fish swim using its fins.

Which statements group the animals by type of movement and by the body parts used? One or more options may be correct.

options.text: The pigeon flies using its wings.
The rabbit hops using its hind legs; the fish swims using its fins.
The pigeon flies using its legs.
Group all three only as outdoor animals, with no split by how they move.

teacher.key_rationale: Correct grouping names both the movement type and the body part: wings to fly, hind legs to hop, fins to swim. Saying the pigeon flies with legs swaps the body part. Grouping only as outdoor animals drops the movement hinge.
